name: Futapunk 2069
source:
After taking part in a cryogenic freezing program, you are unfrozen prematurely and discover a world unlike the one you are from.

Something seems out of place, however, and you want answers!
But at what cost...?

Can you get to the bottom of this?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2235800/]Steam[/url]]
translation: 参加低温冷冻计划后，你提前解冻，发现这个世界与你熟悉的截然不同。似乎有哪里不对劲，你想知道答案！但要付出什么代价……？你能查明真相吗？[引自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2235800/]Steam[/url]]
